post.description: When ADMIN_OTP_REQUIRED is true (default), responds with an OTP challenge — no tokens, no profile — instead of tokens. Complete login via POST /admins/verify-otp.

200.description: Login successful (tokens) or an OTP challenge was issued

post.description: Reads the refresh token from the request body, or falls back to the admin_refresh cookie.

Begin (or restart) TOTP enrollment — stores a pending secret, returns it plus a QR-ready otpauth URI. RE-enrollment (TOTP already enabled) requires `code` — the current TOTP or a backup code — in the body.
Confirm TOTP enrollment with a code from the authenticator app. On success, TOTP is enabled and 8 backup codes are returned (plaintext, once).

delete.description: Disable TOTP — accepts a live TOTP or backup code. Clears the secret and all backup codes.

post.description: Invalidate all existing backup codes and mint a fresh set (plaintext returned once).
Revokes the current session and clears the admin_access/admin_refresh cookies.
Change the caller’s own password (verifies currentPassword). Clears mustChangePassword/tempPasswordExpiresAt and revokes every OTHER session. Exempt from the mustChangePassword gate.
Deprecated — use POST /admins/invites instead. Directly creates an admin with a caller-supplied password; the invite flow issues a temp password and forces a change on first login.
